user.invitesDisabled: New invitations are disabled until an email provider is configured. Existing users can still be edited.
app.name: Protarget pDOOH
common.notImplemented: This screen is not implemented yet.
launch.durationIncompatible: Creative duration incompatible with screen slot.
foundation.scope: Access, inventory, booking and manual CMS records
foundation.future: This module is planned. Delivery and reports are not available yet. Inventory, booking and CMS operation records do not connect a player or verify playback.
auth.description: Organization-scoped access for Protarget operations, agencies and brands.
auth.inviteAccepted: Your account is active. You can now sign in.
auth.inviteInvalid: A valid invitation link is required. Open the link in your email or request a new invitation.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. Invitations are single-use.
auth.passwordInvalid: Passwords must match and not exceed 72 UTF-8 bytes.
auth.expired: Session could not be renewed. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: You are not authorized for this action.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
error.validation: Check the fields. Organization and role must be compatible and required values valid.
error.conflict: The action conflicts with the current state. You cannot disable your own admin account; existing accounts may not be reinvited.
field.name: Name
organization.description: Manage organizations, access status and future financial visibility preferences.
organization.visibilityHint: Financial visibility is off by default. This phase does not include financial data or reporting.
user.inviteSent: Invitation email sent. The account activates after acceptance.
user.deliveryFailed: Email delivery failed; the invitation was revoked. Fix mail settings and invite the same address again.
user.inviteHint: Invitations expire after 24 hours. Role/organization changes and deactivation revoke existing sessions. Media-owner login is not available in this phase.
user.description: Assign compatible organizations and roles. Agencies and advertisers cannot modify business data.
audit.description: Changes and security events. Sensitive fields are redacted; application access cannot modify these records.
dashboard.description: Manage access, register ships and screens, approve manual multipliers, plan bookings and record CMS operations.
dashboard.foundation: Access and manual inventory are available.
dashboard.foundationDescription: Organizations, users, audit, ships/screens and manual multiplier approval are available. Hardware information may be unknown. No CMS connection or verified playback is implied.
dashboard.nextDescription: The booking wizard, creative library and per-screen manual CMS operation record are available. Records are operator declarations, not proof of playback. Delivery and reports are not implemented yet.
dashboard.laterDescription: Verified plays and operator declarations stay separate; estimated impressions are labeled. DSP/SSP integration is outside the MVP.
portal.description: You can access your own organization only. Operations are managed by administrators.
portal.emptyTitle: Campaign tracking is not available yet
portal.emptyDescription: This foundation does not display sample campaigns or fabricated delivery. Campaign access will follow in a later phase.
support.description: Support can access its own identity and service health only. Business data is not accessible.
inventory.description: Admin-only manual inventory. Unknown equipment remains unknown; records do not prove connectivity, audience or playback.
inventory.timezoneHint: Use an IANA zone, for example Europe/Istanbul. Operating hours use the screen time zone.
inventory.codeHint: Unique code: letters, digits, hyphen or underscore. Saved in uppercase. The URL uses the record UUID, not this code.
inventory.codeLocked: This screen code is locked and cannot be changed.
inventory.unknownHint: Leave unknown information blank. No default dimensions, timings or playback claims are assumed. Do not enter passwords or credentials.
inventory.hoursHint: Enter both times or leave both blank. Overnight windows are allowed; equal start/end is invalid.
inventory.emptyVenues: No ships / venues match these filters.
inventory.screenCount: Showing {shown} of {total} screens (search applies to this page)
inventory.emptyChoices: Register a ship / venue first, or load more choices.
inventory.deactivateHint: Deactivation keeps history. Deactivate active screens before deactivating their venue.
inventory.inactiveVenue: The selected venue is inactive. You may edit or deactivate this screen, but cannot activate or reassign it to an inactive venue.
inventory.error.required: Complete all required fields with nonblank values.
inventory.error.timezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Europe/Istanbul.
inventory.error.screenCode: Use 1–64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
inventory.error.hardware: Supplied dimensions and durations must be positive whole numbers. Slot duration cannot exceed loop duration.
inventory.error.hours: Enter a distinct HH:mm start/end pair, or leave both blank.
inventory.error.venueValidation: Check venue name, city, country, time zone and field lengths.
inventory.error.screenValidation: Check the screen code, venue, time zone and optional hardware fields. Unknown values should be blank.
inventory.error.venueConflict: This venue cannot be deactivated while it has active screens. Deactivate those screens first, then retry. A concurrent change may also require reloading.
inventory.error.screenConflict: The screen code may already exist or be locked, or the selected venue may be inactive. Check the record before retrying.
inventory.error.multiplierValidation: Enter a positive decimal (up to 8 integer and 4 fractional digits), a source reference and a change reason. Use a decimal point, not a comma or exponent.
inventory.error.multiplierConflict: The multiplier timeline changed. Refresh the history and retry creating the draft.
inventory.error.approvalValidation: Choose a future start (or server-now) and an end after the start. Check the selected predecessor.
inventory.error.approvalConflict: Approval conflicts with the timeline: overlapping dates, a stale predecessor, a past start or an already approved version. Refresh history, review the dates and explicitly choose the open predecessor to replace.
inventory.error.localTime: This local time does not exist or is invalid. Check the time zone and daylight-saving transition; verify the UTC preview.
multiplier.manualHint: Manual audience assumption · estimated, not verified. Admin approval is not proof of audience or playback. Historical values are not rewritten.
multiplier.noneCurrent: No approved multiplier is effective at this time.
multiplier.displayZone: History displayed in {zone}; stored in UTC. Validity is start-inclusive and end-exclusive.
multiplier.creator: Created by (user ID)
multiplier.inputZone: Input time zone: {zone} (your browser), not the screen time zone. UTC preview is the submitted instant; check it at daylight-saving transitions.
multiplier.noPredecessor: None — do not close another version
multiplier.replacementHint: Only an earlier open, whole-screen approval can be replaced. It will end exactly when this version starts. Other overlaps are rejected; no history is deleted.
multiplier.confirm: I confirm this manual assumption and the displayed validity dates.
multiplier.confirmReplace: I explicitly confirm closing the selected predecessor at the new start time.
multiplier.savedDraft: Draft created. It is not effective until separately approved.
multiplier.savedApproval: Approval saved. Current selection follows the validity dates, not creation order.
inventory.legacyHours: Legacy operating hours are invalid. Untouched values are preserved. To change these hours, enter a valid start/end pair or explicitly clear both.
multiplier.refreshHint: Refreshing history or an approval conflict reloads predecessor choices and clears selection/confirmations. Entered dates are retained; review them again before approving.
booking.description: Admin only: plan bookings, choose screens, creatives, dayparts and goals, and record manual uploads to the existing CMS. Statuses are operator declarations, not proof of physical playback.
creative.description: Upload advertiser creatives, review technical validation and approve or reject them separately. MP4 (H.264), PNG and JPEG; at most 200 MB.
booking.flightEndedHint: The end date has passed but the booking is still LIVE/PAUSED. There is no automatic completion; complete it manually.
booking.operatorDeclaration: Operator declaration — not proof of playback
booking.readyBlocked: This transition is blocked until the blockers are resolved.
booking.liveBlockedCms: A CMS upload record is required for every active screen; some are missing.
booking.limitedEdit: While LIVE/PAUSED only notes can be edited and the end can be extended forward.
booking.wizardHint: Each step saves the draft. There is no Deal step; the booking is planned for manual upload to the existing CMS.
booking.readyEditWarning: If screens, creatives, schedule or commercial fields change while READY, the booking automatically returns to draft.
booking.flightHint: Dates are entered in the {zone} time zone.
booking.error.name: Name must be 3–150 characters.
booking.error.required: Select an advertiser and an internal owner.
booking.error.dates: Enter a valid date and time (nonexistent local times in this zone are not accepted).
booking.error.numbers: A numeric field is invalid: amounts must be positive with at most 4 decimals, quantities positive integers, percentages 0–100.
booking.error.shares: Publisher and Protarget shares must total 100.
booking.error.dayparts: Enter a valid start and end for every daypart; they cannot be equal.
booking.error.future: The operation time cannot be in the future.
booking.error.extendOnly: The end can only be extended forward.
booking.error.pickToAdd: Tick screens that are not yet in the booking to add them.
booking.error.pickToRemove: Tick screens that are in the booking to remove them.
booking.error.tooManyScreens: At most 100 screens can be processed at once.
booking.error.duplicate: This advertiser already has the same file.
booking.error.duplicateRevoked: This file matches a revoked creative of this advertiser; revoked content cannot be uploaded again.
booking.error.uploadUnconfirmed: The upload result could not be confirmed; the record may exist. Check the creative list before uploading again.
booking.error.storage: File storage is not configured or unavailable. The upload failed.
booking.error.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 200 MB limit.
booking.error.notReady: The booking is not ready for this transition: there are blockers or missing CMS upload records.
booking.error.conflict: This action is not possible in the booking’s current state. Refresh and try again.
booking.error.validation: The values entered are invalid. Check the fields.
booking.selectPage: Tick all screens on this page
booking.sharesHint: If both are entered they must total 100. No amounts are calculated.
booking.maxPerHourHint: Informational only; not a capacity calculation.
booking.goalUnitsHint: Playout and impression targets are separate units; they are never converted into each other.
booking.creativesHint: Creatives of {name}. Unapproved creatives can be linked while drafting; READY needs at least one approved creative.
booking.scheduleHint: Dayparts apply to the whole booking and are entered in the {zone} time zone. For an overnight daypart enter an end time earlier than the start.
booking.missingCmsHint: LIVE requires a CMS_UPLOADED declaration for these screens:
validation.blocker.INACTIVE_SCREENS: Some screens or ships are inactive.
validation.blocker.NO_APPROVED_CREATIVE: There is no linked approved creative.
validation.blocker.NO_GOAL: The primary goal or its target is missing.
validation.blocker.NO_SCHEDULE: No daypart schedule has been entered.
validation.blocker.MISSING_MULTIPLIER: Some screens have no multiplier for an impressions goal.
validation.blocker.NO_PLAYBACK_WINDOW: The schedule does not overlap the screens’ known operating hours.
validation.blocker.CREATIVE_TOO_LONG: The video is longer than the known slot length.
validation.blocker.INVALID_COMMERCIAL: The commercial terms are incomplete or inconsistent.
validation.warning.OPERATING_HOURS_UNKNO: Operating hours are unknown for some screens; the overlap could not be computed.
validation.warning.TIMEZONE_MISMATCH: Some screens use a different time zone; the overlap was not computed.
validation.warning.SLOT_LENGTH_UNKNOWN: The slot length is unknown for some screens.
validation.warning.RESOLUTION_MISMATCH: The creative resolution does not match some screens.
validation.warning.UNAPPROVED_CREATIVES: Some linked creatives are not approved.
validation.warning.FLIGHT_ENDED: The flight end date has passed.
booking.cmsAppendOnly: Records are append-only; corrections are new records. The actor and recorded time are set by the server.
creative.displayDurationHint: Required for images, 1–300 s. There is no default.
creative.videoDurationHint: Video duration is measured from the file; it is not entered by hand.
creative.limits: MP4 (H.264), PNG or JPEG; at most 200 MB. The same file cannot be uploaded twice for one advertiser.
creative.uploadedValidating: {code} uploaded. It passed technical validation and awaits admin approval.
creative.error.type: Unsupported file type. Choose MP4, PNG or JPEG.
creative.error.size: The file exceeds the 200 MB limit.
creative.error.duration: Enter a display duration between 1 and 300 s for an image.
creative.reason.NO_VISUAL_STREAM: No visual stream in the file
creative.reason.IMAGE_DECODE_MISMATCH: Image content does not match the file type
creative.reason.NOT_MP4_CONTAINER: The video is not in an MP4 container
creative.reason.VIDEO_CODEC_NOT_H264: The video codec is not H.264
creative.reason.UNKNOWN_DURATION: Video duration could not be read
creative.reason.UNREADABLE_MEDIA: The media file is unreadable or corrupt
booking.cmsStale: Plan changed — a new upload record is required
booking.cmsStaleHint: The plan changed, so the CMS upload record of the screens below is out of date. Record a new “Uploaded to CMS” entry for each; LIVE is only possible after that.
booking.listTruncated: The list is capped at 1000 records; some advertisers, agencies, users or venues may be missing from the options.
creative.revokeHint: A revoked creative cannot be approved again or linked to new bookings. Linked READY bookings return to draft; LIVE/PAUSED bookings keep their status but show a warning.
creative.error.revokeReason: A revocation reason is required (at most 1000 characters).
creative.revokedNotice: This creative was revoked. Unlink it and link a newly approved creative.
validation.warning.FLIGHT_NOT_STARTED: The booking is ready but the flight has not started yet.
validation.warning.CREATIVE_DURATION_UNK: The duration of some approved creatives is unknown; it could not be compared with the slot length.
validation.warning.REVOKED_CREATIVE: A linked creative was revoked. Unlink it.
booking.error.cmsStatus: A CMS operation cannot be recorded in this booking status: only READY, LIVE or PAUSED (notes also in draft).
booking.error.noteRequired: A note text is required for the Note operation type.
booking.error.creativeRevoked: A revoked creative cannot be linked.
booking.error.cmsBeforeBooking: The operation time cannot be before the booking was created.
booking.error.cmsScreen: The selected screen is not part of this booking.
booking.cmsDraftHint: Only notes can be recorded in draft; upload and playback records are entered while READY, LIVE or PAUSED.
booking.cmsTimeHint: Defaults to the current minute. The time cannot be in the future or before the booking was created.
booking.pauseWarning: The last CMS record of these screens is not “Playback paused”. You can still mark the booking as paused; this is an operator declaration.
booking.resumeWarning: The last CMS record of these screens is not “Playback resumed”. You can still mark the booking as live; this is an operator declaration.
booking.archiveText: The draft is removed from the list (archived). This cannot be undone.
booking.pricingNoneText: Setting the pricing model to “Not entered” clears the entered commercial fields (unit price, budget, contracted amount, guaranteed impressions, contracted quantity, shares) when you save.
booking.activity.CAMPAIGN_CREATIVE_REVOK: Approval of a linked creative was revoked
booking.meta.screensWithoutMatchingCmsRe: Screens without a matching CMS record
fleet.description: See ships and screens in a stylised Istanbul Bosphorus simulation. Ship position and motion are simulated; screen states come from the recorded inventory and operator declarations.
fleet.declNote: Operator declaration, not proof of playback.
fleet.scaleNote: Stylised scene: bridge spacing is not to scale.
fleet.layoutNote: On-board screen layout is schematic; the physical screen position is not recorded in the inventory.
fleet.empty: There are no active ships to show. Add an active venue of type “ferry” in the inventory.
fleet.truncatedShips: Showing the first {count} ships; the rest are not in the scene.
fleet.truncatedScreens: Only the first {count} screens of this ship are listed.
fleet.notPlaced: {count} screens are not shown in the schematic layout (max {max}); they remain in the list.
fleet.controls.overview: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom; click a ship.
fleet.controls.desktop: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys, drag to look around. Esc to leave.
fleet.controls.touch: Use the buttons to move, drag to look around.
fleet.noWebgl: The 3D view is not available in this browser/device. The ship and screen list is below.
fleet.field.name: Name
fleet.noDeclarations: No campaign declaration is recorded on this screen.
fleet.selectScreenHint: Select a screen: click it in the 3D scene or pick it from the ship list.
fleet.scaleNote.adalar: Stylised map: distances are not to scale, routes are simulated.
addon.description: Areas missing compared with Broadsign. All are passive by default; enabling a module never changes the existing booking flow, its statuses or CMS operation records.
addon.notReady: Its code arrives in a later story of this sprint; it cannot be enabled yet.
addon.placeholderNote: This area needs an external system and cannot be enabled in this version. No sample data, statistics or connection status is shown.
addon.confirmEnable: Enable {name}? The existing booking flow does not change; the action is written to the audit log.
addon.disabledNote: This module is passive. Use the Add-ons page to enable it.
error.addonNotAvailable: This add-on cannot be enabled in this version.
addon.playback.name: Playback and CMS
addon.playback.summary: Sending content to screens, loop/slot scheduling, player health, offline playback and remote device management.
addon.proofOfPlay.name: Proof of play
addon.proofOfPlay.summary: Importing playback logs exported from the CMS; per-screen timestamped records with source label and de-duplication.
addon.capacity.name: Capacity and availability
addon.capacity.summary: Per-screen loop/slot capacity, occupancy, overbooking/conflict warnings and temporary holds.
addon.sales.name: Sales tools
addon.sales.summary: Rate card, packages and a proposal document from a campaign. Discount approval and invoicing are placeholders.
addon.programmatic.name: Programmatic sales
addon.programmatic.summary: SSP/DSP connection, OpenRTB, PMP/PG, Deal ID, floor price and auctions.
addon.audience.name: Audience measurement
addon.audience.summary: Sensor/camera or third-party audience data integration.
addon.dynamicContent.name: Dynamic content
addon.dynamicContent.summary: Weather, time or location triggered content and DCO.
addon.buyerCatalog.name: Buyer catalog
addon.buyerCatalog.summary: Agencies and brands see inventory read-only in the portal. Booking requests are a placeholder; only admins write.
addon.reporting.name: Delivery reports
addon.reporting.summary: Delivery and client reports by campaign, screen and day, with each figure's source and verification level.
addon.req.player: Our own player on the screens, or permission to install on the CMS player
addon.req.cmsApi: CMS name/version and API or licence access
addon.req.cmsExport: A real playback log sample exported from the CMS (to verify the format)
addon.req.loopSlot: Loop and slot lengths entered on the screens
addon.req.sspContract: A separate commercial agreement with an SSP/DSP
addon.req.audienceSource: Sensor/camera hardware or a third-party audience data contract
addon.req.deliveryData: Imported playback logs or operator declarations
capacity.rule: Capacity = loop length / slot length. Each READY, LIVE and PAUSED booking takes one slot during its dayparts; active holds take their slot count. This screen is information only and never blocks a booking.
capacity.empty: No active screen for this filter.
capacity.holdsDescription: Reserves slots for requests still at the proposal stage. A hold only affects the occupancy calculation; it neither creates nor blocks a booking. Expired holds are not counted.
capacity.utcInputs: Date/time fields are read as UTC.
delivery.importDescription: Import playbacks exported from the CMS or declared by the operator as CSV. Preview first; if any line is invalid nothing is written. The same record is never counted twice; sources stay labelled separately and are not summed.
delivery.columns: A header row is required. Columns: {columns}. played_at must be UTC (e.g. 2026-11-13T09:30:00Z). This is a generic format; the real CMS export format is not verified yet.
delivery.sourceHint.CMS_VERIFIED: Only for files taken from the CMS's own playback log. An "uploaded" record is not proof of play.
delivery.sourceHint.OPERATOR_DECLARED: Playbacks reported by the operator; a declaration, not verified proof of play.
delivery.sourceHint.DECLARED_IMPRESSION: Impressions are declared directly; the impressions column is required and count must stay empty. It is not counted as playouts.
delivery.tooLarge: The file is too large (max 60 KB). Split it or aggregate rows with the count column.
delivery.noFile: Choose a file or paste text first.
delivery.fixLines: The file has invalid lines; fix the lines listed in the preview.
delivery.rowError.MALFORMED_CSV: CSV could not be read (unterminated quote).
delivery.rowError.EMPTY_FILE: The file has no data lines.
delivery.rowError.COLUMN_COUNT: The number of columns does not match the header.
delivery.rowError.IMPRESSIONS_NOT_ALLOWE: Impressions are not allowed for this source.
delivery.rowError.COUNT_NOT_ALLOWED: A playout count is not allowed for declared impressions.
delivery.rowError.SCREEN_NOT_IN_CAMPAIGN: The screen is not in this campaign.
delivery.rowError.CREATIVE_NOT_IN_CAMPAI: The creative is not in this campaign.
delivery.voidReason: Reason for voiding (at least 3 characters). The row is kept but leaves the reports:
delivery.rowError.CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE: The same playout already arrived with different figures (count/duration/impressions). Give an external_id if it is a separate row; void the old row if it is a correction.
report.rule: Each source is shown separately and never summed; the same playout may appear in both the CMS log and an operator declaration. Estimated impressions = playouts × the approved screen multiplier valid at that time. Delivery % is per source; without a goal it is not computed.
report.partial: partial — {count} playouts have no valid multiplier
report.pickHint: Choose a campaign for the report.
report.portalDescription: Only your organisation's campaigns, read-only. Each figure shows its source and verification level.
report.truncated: The list is limited to the first 1,000 campaigns; for older ones use the campaign id from the campaign page.
sales.ratesDescription: List price of one slot for one day per screen. Versioned: a new price never changes the old record and applies from its own start. It cannot be backdated.
sales.packagesDescription: A named group of screens sold together. A package does not create a booking; it is for proposals and sales talks.
sales.placeholdersNote: Placeholder: discount approval and invoicing are not in this version. Invoicing needs an e-invoice integrator and accounting rules; the proposal shows list prices only.
sales.missingRates: {count} screens have no price valid at the campaign start; the total excludes them.
sales.proposalNote: List amount = daily list price × flight days (fractional). Prices are the versions valid at {date}. No discount, tax or invoice; not a binding offer.
catalog.title: Inventory catalog
catalog.description: Screens on active ships with their technical details. Read-only; bookings are made by the Protarget team.
catalog.pricesVisible: List prices are for information; no discount or tax, not binding.
catalog.pricesHidden: Prices are not opened for your organisation; contact the Protarget team for a proposal.
catalog.requestNote: Placeholder: booking requests from the portal are not in this version. Agency and brand accounts are read-only; send your request to the Protarget team.
